attack_plan.narrative: Since the last reported sighting of Putin in St. Petersburg on March 13, there have been numerous unconfirmed reports of his movements. Speculation is rife about his current location and condition, with some sources claiming he may be in hiding due to internal political pressures. Reports indicate Putin has been observed at a classified Russian military base near Moscow, undergoing routine health checks. His absence from public view is attributed to his need for rest and recuperation. High-ranking officials within the Kremlin have confirmed that Putin is under close surveillance by security personnel. There are unverified claims that these individuals are part of a faction seeking to overthrow Putin, leading to speculation about a potential palace coup. Brian Williams, former anchor of NBC News, and Bill O’Reilly, former host of Fox News, have both expressed concerns about Putin’s whereabouts, hinting at the possibility of a coup within the Russian government.
